supersedes.reason: v1 computed firstCallDeltaCi95 as the min/max range of observed paired differences (quantile of the diff sample), not a 95% CI of the paired mean; see ab-v1-defect-note.md

design.stoppingRule: fixed n=40 pairs; no early stopping; exactly one live run after this protocol is written

toolSelection.meaning: a query asks for an action; control exposes full schemas, treatment exposes summaries only
toolSelection.expected: the expected tool is the only tool whose description fits the query

schemaExpansion.meaning: a query asks for the full schema of a tool that exists in the catalog
schemaExpansion.expected: control selects it directly; treatment must request it through tool_describe first

metrics.primaryDefinition: control: first model turn returns {"tool":<expected>}; treatment: first model turn returns {"call":"tool_describe","tool":<expected>}; either arm may use up to maxToolTurns=2; success requires the correct tool before any other tool is chosen or any non-tool action is taken
metrics.secondaryDefinition: provider-reported input_tokens(control) - input_tokens(treatment) over the same 40 fixtures; reduction = control - treatment; positive means fewer input tokens
metrics.diagnosticOnly: character-count delta, recorded but never used to decide the gate

thresholds.firstCallNonInferiority: paired bootstrap 95% CI of (treatment success rate - control success rate), fixed seed 20261023, 10000 resamples, percentile method; lower bound >= -0.05
thresholds.schemaTokenReduction: mean per-pair provider input-token reduction > 0 AND its paired bootstrap 95% CI (same seed/resamples) lower bound > 0
thresholds.noProviderErrors: provider errors must be 0 of 80 calls
thresholds.insufficientOrNeutral: if any threshold fails, TF-0502 must not graduate

evidencePolicy.tokenAccounting: provider usage only; no local tokenizer
